titleEn: Minimum Cost to Convert String II
title: 转换字符串的最小成本 II
summary: 给定若干等长字符串转换规则及其成本；每次操作选择的原下标区间必须与其他操作区间相离或完全相同，求把 source 转为 target 的最小总成本，不可能时返回 -1。
insight: 同一区间上的连续操作只会在等长规则串之间移动，可先把所有规则串作为图节点并用 Floyd 求任意两串的最短转换成本。不同操作区间必须相离，因此再用前缀 DP 划分 source；从每个可达位置同时沿字典树匹配 source 与 target，遇到两边都是完整规则串时用预处理距离转移。
pitfalls: 规则有方向，反向转换不一定存在
重复规则边必须保留最小直接成本，多步转换也可能更便宜
同一操作链始终作用于完全相同的区间，不同区间只能相离，因此可以按前缀划分
某一位字符相同时可以零成本跳过，但仍要继续尝试包含该位的更长规则串
只有 source 与 target 的同长度子串都属于规则串图时才能使用转换距离
总成本可能超过 32 位整数，距离和 DP 都必须使用 long

solutions.title: 字典树、全源最短路与前缀 DP
solutions.idea: 预处理规则串之间的最短路，再枚举互不相交的转换区间。
steps: 把 original 与 changed 中的不同字符串编号并插入同一棵字典树
建立编号间距离矩阵，重复有向边取最小成本
用 Floyd 求所有规则串之间的最短转换成本
令 dp[i] 为转换前 i 个字符的最小成本，dp[0]=0
若 source[i]==target[i]，用零成本更新 dp[i+1]
从 i 开始同时沿字典树扫描 source 与 target
当两边节点都是完整规则串且可达时，用其最短距离更新对应前缀
返回 dp[n]，不可达则返回 -1

code.java: class Solution { static class Node { Node[] next=new Node[26];int id=-1;}Node root;private int getId(String word,Map<String,Integer> ids){Integer found=ids.get(word);if(found!=null)return found;int id=ids.size();ids.put(word,id);Node node=root;for(char letter:word.toCharArray()){int index=letter-'a';if(node.next[index]==null)node.next[index]=new Node();node=node.next[index];}node.id=id;return id;}public long minimumCost(String source,String target,String[] original,String[] changed,int[] cost){root=new Node();Map<String,Integer> ids=new HashMap<>();for(int i=0;i<cost.length;i++){getId(original[i],ids);getId(changed[i],ids);}long infinity=Long.MAX_VALUE/4;long[][] distance=new long[ids.size()][ids.size()];for(int from=0;from<distance.length;from++){Arrays.fill(distance[from],infinity);distance[from][from]=0;}for(int i=0;i<cost.length;i++){int from=ids.get(original[i]),to=ids.get(changed[i]);distance[from][to]=Math.min(distance[from][to],cost[i]);}for(int middle=0;middle<distance.length;middle++)for(int from=0;from<distance.length;from++)if(distance[from][middle]<infinity)for(int to=0;to<distance.length;to++)if(distance[middle][to]<infinity)distance[from][to]=Math.min(distance[from][to],distance[from][middle]+distance[middle][to]);long[] dp=new long[source.length()+1];Arrays.fill(dp,infinity);dp[0]=0;for(int start=0;start<source.length();start++){if(dp[start]==infinity)continue;if(source.charAt(start)==target.charAt(start))dp[start+1]=Math.min(dp[start+1],dp[start]);Node fromNode=root,toNode=root;for(int end=start;end<source.length();end++){fromNode=fromNode.next[source.charAt(end)-'a'];toNode=toNode.next[target.charAt(end)-'a'];if(fromNode==null||toNode==null)break;if(fromNode.id>=0&&toNode.id>=0&&distance[fromNode.id][toNode.id]<infinity)dp[end+1]=Math.min(dp[end+1],dp[start]+distance[fromNode.id][toNode.id]);}}return dp[source.length()]==infinity?-1:dp[source.length()];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private class Node{val next=arrayOfNulls<Node>(26);var id=-1}private lateinit var root:Node;private fun getId(word:String,ids:HashMap<String,Int>):Int{val found=ids[word];if(found!=null)return found;val id=ids.size;ids[word]=id;var node=root;for(letter in word){val index=letter-'a';if(node.next[index]==null)node.next[index]=Node();node=node.next[index]!!};node.id=id;return id}fun minimumCost(source:String,target:String,original:Array<String>,changed:Array<String>,cost:IntArray):Long{root=Node();val ids=HashMap<String,Int>();for(i in cost.indices){getId(original[i],ids);getId(changed[i],ids)};val infinity=Long.MAX_VALUE/4;val distance=Array(ids.size){from->LongArray(ids.size){to->if(from==to)0L else infinity}};for(i in cost.indices){val from=ids[original[i]]!!;val to=ids[changed[i]]!!;distance[from][to]=minOf(distance[from][to],cost[i].toLong())};for(middle in distance.indices)for(from in distance.indices)if(distance[from][middle]<infinity)for(to in distance.indices)if(distance[middle][to]<infinity)distance[from][to]=minOf(distance[from][to],distance[from][middle]+distance[middle][to]);val dp=LongArray(source.length+1){infinity};dp[0]=0;for(start in source.indices){if(dp[start]==infinity)continue;if(source[start]==target[start])dp[start+1]=minOf(dp[start+1],dp[start]);var fromNode=root;var toNode=root;for(end in start until source.length){val nextFrom=fromNode.next[source[end]-'a']?:break;val nextTo=toNode.next[target[end]-'a']?:break;fromNode=nextFrom;toNode=nextTo;if(fromNode.id>=0&&toNode.id>=0&&distance[fromNode.id][toNode.id]<infinity)dp[end+1]=minOf(dp[end+1],dp[start]+distance[fromNode.id][toNode.id])}};return if(dp[source.length]==infinity)-1 else dp[source.length]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { struct Node{array<int,26> next;int id;Node():id(-1){next.fill(-1);}};vector<Node> trie;int getId(const string& word,unordered_map<string,int>& ids){auto found=ids.find(word);if(found!=ids.end())return found->second;int id=ids.size();ids[word]=id;int node=0;for(char letter:word){int index=letter-'a',next=trie[node].next[index];if(next==-1){next=trie.size();trie[node].next[index]=next;trie.emplace_back();}node=next;}trie[node].id=id;return id;}public:long long minimumCost(string source,string target,vector<string>& original,vector<string>& changed,vector<int>& cost){trie.clear();trie.emplace_back();unordered_map<string,int> ids;for(int i=0;i<(int)cost.size();++i){getId(original[i],ids);getId(changed[i],ids);}const long long INF=LLONG_MAX/4;vector<vector<long long>> distance(ids.size(),vector<long long>(ids.size(),INF));for(int node=0;node<(int)ids.size();++node)distance[node][node]=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)cost.size();++i){int from=ids[original[i]],to=ids[changed[i]];distance[from][to]=min(distance[from][to],1LL*cost[i]);}for(int middle=0;middle<(int)distance.size();++middle)for(int from=0;from<(int)distance.size();++from)if(distance[from][middle]<INF)for(int to=0;to<(int)distance.size();++to)if(distance[middle][to]<INF)distance[from][to]=min(distance[from][to],distance[from][middle]+distance[middle][to]);vector<long long> dp(source.size()+1,INF);dp[0]=0;for(int start=0;start<(int)source.size();++start){if(dp[start]==INF)continue;if(source[start]==target[start])dp[start+1]=min(dp[start+1],dp[start]);int fromNode=0,toNode=0;for(int end=start;end<(int)source.size();++end){fromNode=trie[fromNode].next[source[end]-'a'];toNode=trie[toNode].next[target[end]-'a'];if(fromNode==-1||toNode==-1)break;int fromId=trie[fromNode].id,toId=trie[toNode].id;if(fromId>=0&&toId>=0&&distance[fromId][toId]<INF)dp[end+1]=min(dp[end+1],dp[start]+distance[fromId][toId]);}}return dp[source.size()]==INF?-1:dp[source.size()];} };
